name: obsidian-scholarium
description: A scholarly electronic lab notebook plugin for Obsidian

scripts.build:base: node scripts/check-style-scope.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build: npm run build:base && node tools/embed-runtime-bootstrap.js && node tools/embed-native-weaver.js && node tools/embed-logo.js && node scripts/check-release-bundle.mjs && node --check main.js
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
